newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde May 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde May 22.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- UDF conservative party leader Francois Leotard in an interview calls for a modernisation of political life, sees need for further reform of the social security system.
-- Supermarkets group Intermarche buys controlling stake in German retailer Spar AG, gains strong position in German retail market.
-- Oil group Total shares boosted by hopes for success in Iran gas contract and discovery of oil field in Angola.

-- The CDR company set up to sell off assets from Credit Lyonnais says there was organised fraud in the state-owned bank's subsidiaries until 1993, and that total losses may be higher than forecast so far.
-- Unions at insurer GAN to file court complaint against restructuring plan including some 591 job cuts, notably on grounds it does not detail accompanying measures.
